scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute distance from a query point to every planar record and select the nearest k associated record IDs.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: d_i = sqrt((lat_i-query_lat)^2 + (lng_i-query_lng)^2); strict-less-than partial selection of k distances and associated records.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Unstructured 2D coordinate points; planar coordinate units, no spherical metric.
invariants: Nonnegative finite distances; exact zero at identical coordinates.
Returned record IDs form a full permutation and selected unique minima retain distance-record association.
accuracy_requirements: Exact actual-device input bit-prefix, record IDs, guards and analytic zero/axis controls.
Full finite distances against independent Float64 norm within atol1e-5 + 8eps(Float32)*abs(reference).
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 subtraction, products and sqrt can round differently; geographic-coordinate interpretation is outside the numerical contract.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: N=1,17,65,4099,131072 with10000 internal launches/case; no saturation/scaling or full external dataset claim.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Nearest-record coordinate lookup in the source benchmark; application data quality is not established by synthetic fixtures.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: No realworld dataset validation; planar metric does not certify geographical distance.

cuda_jl.algorithm: Native Float32 planar norm and guarded point map; CPU partial record selection outside ROI
cuda_jl.layout: LatLong isbits AoS twoFloat32 fields,8bytes; input/output guard regions

precision.artifact_encoding: float64, including lossless UInt32 bit-word numeric encoding

cuda_jl.memory: Global input/output; no authored shared tile or atomics
cuda_jl.library_boundary: Backend runtime allocation/copy/completion outside ROI; ordinary compiler-lowered sqrt, no foreign CUDA device calls
limitations: Conditional minimal native CPU record-value-swap repair; original CUDA device body unchanged; untouched-native aggregate excluded.
Planar Euclidean coordinate distance, not geodesic distance or a scientifically validated geographical model.
Named synthetic AoS cases, not original external weather dataset/fileparser/default-throughput certification.
